name: Pinthong Industrial Park Public Company Limited
summary: Pinthong Industrial Park Public Company Limited (PIPCL) focuses on developing and managing industrial estates and logistics facilities. Beyond these primary activities, the company also oversees the development and administration of diverse real estate holdings, including factory premises, and provides rental warehouse services. Headquartered in Chonburi, Thailand, and founded in 1995, PIPCL operates in key markets such as Japan, Thailand, China, and Taiwan.
